title: Dotted flow

reference.source: Reference 24: pointillist flow print in teal, red and white on dark gray, 640 × 960 px PNG.
reference.note: held locally; this page carries statistics measured from it and none of its pixels

summary: Rows of round dots along the streamlines of one flow, each dot colored by a field sampled along its row, so color runs along rows and a band of rows bunched by the flow prints as a white river.
units: reference pixels; the plate is 640 × 960 and every length scales with the canvas

pitch.does: Spacing of dots along a row; the reference's nearest-neighbor spacing is 6.3 px.

rows.does: Distance between rows across the flow, outside the river.

radius.does: Radius of every dot; the reference's components have a median area of 21 px.

stagger.does: Offset of every second row by half a pitch; 1 packs the dots hexagonally, 0 aligns them in columns.

jitter.does: Random offset of each dot from its place on the row.

vary.does: Per-dot variation of size and tint.

grain.does: Speckle of the dark ground between the dots.

margin.does: Bare ground around the field: 11 px on the left, top and bottom of the reference, 6 px on the right.

wave.does: Swing of the main wave the rows follow.

wavelength.does: Length of one full wave; a second wave at 0.43 of this length rides on it.

tilt.does: Rotation of the whole flow; at 12 the rows fall gently from left to right.

swirl.does: Height of a dome in the stream function that the upper rows bow around; negative bows them the other way.

spread.does: Slow variation of row spacing: where the rows open the dark ground shows between them as lines; where they close the dots crowd.

turbulence.does: Slow noise warp of the coordinates, so the rows wander off the clean sine.

river.does: Where the white river crosses the plate.

riverW.does: Width of the band of rows that print white end to end.

converge.does: How much tighter the rows pack inside the river: the stream function is this much steeper there.

creamReach.does: How far the white field reaches along the rows just above the river, from the left edge.

creamRows.does: How many rows above the river the cream field covers; its reach falls off row by row, so its edge sweeps down into the river.

run.does: Length of the color runs along a row.

bandRows.does: Across the flow, how many rows share a run's color before the field changes.

red.does: Share of red runs below the river.

shadeMix.does: How the three teals are chosen: 0 runs them along the rows like the red, 1 scatters them dot by dot.

dark.does: Share of teal dots printed in the deep teal that barely lifts off the ground; they read as gaps in the rows.

cream.does: Single white dots scattered in the teal above the river: one in 170 at 1.

seed.does: Re-rolls the warp, the runs and the bands.

phase.does: Position along the loop: slides the wave along the rows.

modes.saw: value up to value + amp over period seconds, then again
modes.drift: seeded walk, one step of up to amp every period seconds, folded back at the slider ends

motion.runs: only while Motion is on, at half scale; the sliders hold the center values; off by default

live.runs: only while Live is on: a drag on the figure sets x across and y down between these ends; off by default

techniques.name: Tone
techniques.implementation: The white field: whole rows of white dots, each ending at its own place as it meets the teal.

techniques.name: Flow
techniques.implementation: The river: rows of white packed 1.45 times tighter than the rows beside them, running the width of the plate.

techniques.name: Grain
techniques.implementation: Where rows bunch, the dots stay round: the local frame comes from the stream function's own slope.

techniques.name: Edge
techniques.implementation: The margin: 11 px of bare ground, then the rows begin mid-dot.

techniques.name: Paper
techniques.implementation: Ground between dots: dark gray with a 1 px speckle, about 60 % of the plate.

pass_order: flow: tilted coordinates warped by slow noise; a stream function of two sines, a dome the upper rows bow around, and a slow term that opens and closes the gaps between rows
the river: around one level of the stream function the function is made steeper, so a band of rows packs 1.45 times tighter and crosses the plate as one bundle
pass 1 stores the stream function and the arc coordinate at every pixel; pass 2 reads the local frame from their differences, so each dot stays round where the rows bend, fan or bunch
dots: along every row at a fixed pitch, every second row offset by half a pitch; each dot jittered and sized by a hash; every pixel takes the nearest dot through a soft edge

color: one field sampled along each row, in row and arc coordinates, so a row holds a color for a run and the next row may differ; river rows print white end to end; above the river the white reaches back along each row from the left edge, further on rows nearer the river, with a ragged end per row; below it the runs turn red; teals and a deep teal fill the rest
ground: dark gray with a 1 px speckle and an 11 px bare margin

dot_component_area_px.method: connected components of pixels above L 75

measured.lattice_evidence: autocorrelation of the dot mask peaks at 6.4, 12.8 and 19.2 px along one direction

margin_px.method: column and row means of L fall to the ground's 53

measured.river: a band of 4 to 6 white rows from (0, 380) through (300, 430) to (640, 470), rows tighter than the field around it
measured.white_field: upper left, x under 200 at the top, its edge sweeping down to the river by x 120 at y 350

shares_whole.method: nearest-ink share over the whole plate

measured.rejected: a 2-D blob field for color (the first build): it printed red as patches that cut across rows; the reference's red runs along rows

benchmark.computed: live, when this page loads, by the code that measured the reference: default parameters, Teal, red, white palette, 1× reference size

setup.note: The composition moved (white field, river, red half), so the teal field, red field, white rows and zone edge rects were re-picked with search.py on the plate's own zones: teal above the river at (192, 96), red below it at (512, 720), white rows in the white field at (112, 64), the river edge at (448, 448). The whole plate compares in place.

limits: Benchmark mean 0.953, lowest 0.80 (red field texture spectrum). Under 98 % on: the tone histograms (0.86 to 0.89) and the red field's spectrum and autocorrelation (0.80, 0.82). The reference's dots are hand-placed along each streamline, so neighboring rows do not keep a fixed phase and its autocorrelation decays to zero by lag 4; the plate's rows keep a half-pitch stagger, which leaves a rebound at lags 5 to 7 even with 2.6 px of jitter. The white field's histogram misses because the reference's white dots run in many tints from (210,200,180) to (250,248,240) and the plate's vary by 15 %.

The flow is an original arrangement: the white field, the river and the red half sit where the reference's do in outline, the rows and runs do not, so four of the five rects were placed with search.py.
Dots that fall below L 75 (the darkest teals) were not separated by the component measure, so the dot radius may be read slightly small.
notes: Deterministic: the same palette, parameters and seed give the same pixels.
A display render is capped at 2.4 megapixels; a slider in motion draws at half scale (down to a quarter on a heavy engine) and the release redraws in full.
